**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/04/10 (Mon) 10:13
- [FACT] Tommy and Mark are friends.
- [EVENT] Tommy and Mark traveled back in time using a time portal watch.
- [CHANGE] Tommy gained a new understanding and empathy for his father after seeing his past.
- [RELATIONSHIP] Tommy's father is mentioned; Tommy reflects on his father's childhood experiences.
- [PREFERENCE] Tommy expresses a desire to be a better son and to understand his father better.
